name: medrelay-accessibility-test-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling: axe-core, used exclusively by Playwright-based accessibility tests (tests/accessibility/test_axe_scans.py). Never imported by, bundled into, or shipped with the running Django application - see that test file's module docstring for how it is loaded (a local file path injected via Playwright's add_script_tag, never a CDN reference from app code).
